zh.title: 星宇航空首航台北－布拉格　正式開啟歐洲航線布局
zh.summary: 星宇航空於 2026 年 8 月 1 日正式開航台北－布拉格航線，這是該公司首條歐洲定期航線，也使布拉格成為星宇航空進軍歐洲市場的第一個航點。首航班機由星宇航空董事長張國煒親自執飛，該航線初期每週營運 3 班，並預計自 10 月起增為每週 4 班。
body: 星宇航空於 2026 年 8 月 1 日正式開航台北－布拉格航線，這是該公司首條歐洲定期航線，也使布拉格成為星宇航空進軍歐洲市場的第一個航點。首航班機由星宇航空董事長張國煒親自執飛，該航線初期每週營運 3 班，並預計自 10 月起增為每週 4 班。
首航當天，桃園國際機場（TPE）候機室以布拉格城市意象進行布置，並設置蔡依林主題拍照區，呼應星宇航空為本次航線推出的宣傳合作。星宇航空也同步推出與布拉格航線相關的首航禮與聯名贈品，凸顯其將品牌活動、旅客體驗與新航線推廣結合的策略。
根據星宇航空先前公布的航班規劃，台北桃園國際機場（TPE）往返布拉格瓦茨拉夫・哈維爾機場（PRG）的去程航班為 JX101，當地時間凌晨起飛、清晨抵達；回程航班 JX102 則於上午自布拉格出發、翌日清晨返抵台北。該航線使用空中巴士 A350-900 執飛，屬於長程廣體客機，並採多艙等配置，適合洲際直飛市場的營運需求。
布拉格是捷克首都，也是中歐重要的觀光與商務城市，過去與台灣之間的直飛航班選擇相對有限，因此星宇航空此次開航，除了補足台灣與捷克之間的空中連結，也有助於銜接歐洲觀光、商務洽公與轉機需求。對星宇航空而言，這條航線不僅是國際網路擴張的一步，也代表其正式跨入歐洲市場。

en.title: Starlux Airlines Launches Taipei–Prague Route, Officially Beginning European Network Expansion
en.summary: Starlux Airlines officially launched its Taipei–Prague route on August 1, 2026, marking the carrier's first scheduled European service and making Prague the first destination in Starlux Airlines' entry into the European market. The inaugural flight was piloted personally by Starlux Airlines Chairman Chang Kuo-wei. The route will initially operate 3 flights per week, with plans to increase to 4 flights per week starting in October.
body: Starlux Airlines officially launched its Taipei–Prague route on August 1, 2026, marking the carrier's first scheduled European service and making Prague the first destination in Starlux Airlines' entry into the European market. The inaugural flight was piloted personally by Starlux Airlines Chairman Chang Kuo-wei. The route will initially operate 3 flights per week, with plans to increase to 4 flights per week starting in October.

On the day of the inaugural flight, the departure lounge at Taoyuan International Airport (TPE) was decorated with Prague city imagery and featured a Jolin Tsai-themed photo area, echoing the promotional collaboration Starlux Airlines launched for this route. Starlux Airlines also simultaneously introduced inaugural gifts and co-branded merchandise related to the Prague route, highlighting its strategy of integrating brand campaigns, passenger experience, and new route promotion.

According to the flight plan previously announced by Starlux Airlines, the outbound service between Taipei Taoyuan International Airport (TPE) and Prague Václav Havel Airport (PRG) is flight JX101, departing in the early morning local time and arriving at dawn. The return flight, JX102, departs from Prague in the morning and arrives back in Taipei the following morning. The route is operated with the Airbus A350-900, a long-range wide-body aircraft configured with multiple cabin classes, suited to the operational requirements of the intercontinental nonstop market.

Prague is the capital of the Czech Republic and an important tourism and business city in Central Europe. Direct flight options between Prague and Taiwan have historically been relatively limited, so this launch by Starlux Airlines not only fills the air link between Taiwan and the Czech Republic but also helps connect European tourism, business travel, and transfer demand. For Starlux Airlines, this route represents not only a step in international network expansion but also its formal entry into the European market.
